anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
**Routing:** The `**PR:** acme/widget#99` header does not select header-linked finishing, and it does not trigger a coordinated re-settle. The `## Rework record` takes precedence, so home is **#42**. This is N=1: there is no `Absorbs:` line, no close question, and the Threads list is unlabeled. The record keeps every existing delivery check and the body append.

## Order (row 1)

1. **Capture evidence before the strip.**
   - Scoped verification set: `test-timeout`, `test-retry`, `lint`, `format`. All four passed at `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`.
   - Task and thread evidence for T1–T5.
2. **Refetch #42 threads** with the [pr-head](../using-git-worktrees/reference/pr-head.md) paginated query (`-F n=42`).
3. **Strip the plan.** Run the guarded `git rm` and `Remove ephemeral plan doc` commit.
4. **Seal the telemetry record:**
   `node <bin>/gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs --worktree "/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-timeout" --option pr --base origin/main --spec doc/specs/rework.md`
   This measures the whole PR, never `PRE_REWORK_HEAD`.
5. **Create the missing local ref:**
   - Probe: `git -C "$WORKTREE" rev-parse -q --verify refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42` (absent).
   - Create: `git -C "$WORKTREE" update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42 aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`
6. **Push.** The record is a merge record, so this is a non-force push:
   `git -C "$WORKTREE" push --no-follow-tags origin HEAD:refs/heads/fix-timeout`
7. **FETCH the current body:** `gh pr view 42 -R acme/widget --json body`
   - Decode the JSON without trimming.
   - Write the result to a `mktemp` scratch file outside the repo.
8. **EDIT the body:** `gh pr edit 42 -R acme/widget --body-file <scratch>`

## Threads

**Naming-commit count:**
`git -C "$WORKTREE" log --first-parent --format=%h --grep '<thread id>' bbbbbbb..HEAD`
(The merge SHA is the first recorded value present.)

| Thread | Disposition | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| T1 | `fixed in ddddddd` | Accepted complete, one naming commit |
| T2 | `fixed (task "<T2 title>" complete; no single commit names T2)` | Accepted complete, zero naming commits |
| T3 | `fixed (task "<T3 title>" complete; no single commit names T3)` | Accepted complete, two naming commits |
| T4 | `still open` | Task incomplete; a naming commit or file touch is not proof |
| T5 | `still open` | Task missing; a path match is not proof |
| T6 | `still open` | Recorded keep open |
| T7 | `declined - incompatible API` | Recorded decline |
| T8 | `still open` | Newly opened |
| T9 | omitted | Now resolved on GitHub |

Independent fetch outcomes:
- **Empty fetch:** the list is replaced by `Threads: none`.
- **Failed fetch:** the list is replaced by `Threads: not fetched (<gh error>)`.

## Scratch body (exact bytes)

The original claims are not all dropped (`Dropped claims: none`), so the block has no `supersedes` line. The original bytes are preserved verbatim, followed by one blank line, then the block:

```
Original description

## Rework

Before: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa (local ref `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42` in the rework checkout)
Spec: doc/specs/rework.md at <pushed HEAD7>
Keeps: retry behavior
Changes: repair timeout
Dropped claims: none
Verification: scoped - test-timeout, test-retry, lint, format; CI on this push holds the full run. Telemetry: whole PR against main.
Threads:
- <T1 path:line> - fixed in ddddddd
- <T2 path:line> - fixed (task "<T2 title>" complete; no single commit names T2)
- <T3 path:line> - fixed (task "<T3 title>" complete; no single commit names T3)
- <T4 path:line> - still open
- <T5 path:line> - still open
- <T6 path:line> - still open
- <T7 path:line> - declined - incompatible API
- <T8 path:line> - still open
```

## Success

```
gauntlet: done pushed
sealed .pi/gauntlet/telemetry/doc/specs/rework.yaml
Pushed to PR #42 (fix-timeout); Rework block appended.
```

After this message, run `phase_tracker({ action: "complete", phase: "ship" })`.

## Independent failures

| Failure | Effect |
|---|---|
| **Strip fails** | `gauntlet: stuck plan strip failed`. Stops before seal, ref creation and push; nothing lands. |
| **Seal exits nonzero** | `gauntlet: stuck telemetry seal failed`, quoting `seal failed record: denied`. The seal has already restored the pre-seal bytes. Stops before the first landing command (no ref, no push); the user decides. |
| **Ref creation fails** | `gauntlet: stuck update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42 failed`, followed by the error. No push. |
| **Push rejected** | `gauntlet: stuck push rejected`, reported once. Skips the body edit (no members to name). Worktree preserved. Then a new gate message re-renders the subject menu with preflight recomputed. |
| **Body edit fails after a successful push** | `gauntlet: stuck PR #42 body edit failed`. The push is kept. Prints the error plus the Rework block above for manual paste. The description is never replaced with only the block. Ship is not marked complete. |

No retries, force pushes, thread replies, PR merges, closures or ticket changes on any path.

Record **acme/widget#42** takes precedence: header #99 selects neither header-linked finishing nor coordinated re-settle. Retain all record-42 delivery checks and the existing-body append. No absorbed members are recorded, so no closure question applies.

### Shared preparation and landing order

1. **Before stripping**, capture the plan’s accepted-complete evidence and verification union: `test-timeout`, `test-retry`, `lint`, `format`. All passed at clean commit `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`; apply the passed skip checks before reusing that evidence.
2. Refetch #42’s threads using the prescribed paginated thread/comment queries. Omit resolved T9. Count naming commits only for accepted-complete tasks:
   ```bash
   git -C "$WORKTREE" log --first-parent --format=%h --grep '<thread id>' bbbbbbb..HEAD
   ```
3. Read the artifact’s `**Spec:**`, retain its evidence, then remove tracked paired task-plan and ledger candidates and commit their removal. Preserve the spec and telemetry.
4. Seal:
   ```bash
   node <bin>/gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs --worktree /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-timeout --option pr --base origin/main --spec doc/specs/rework.md
   ```
5. Probe, then create the missing original-head ref:
   ```bash
   git -C "$WORKTREE" rev-parse -q --verify refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42
   git -C "$WORKTREE" update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42 aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
   ```
6. Push, without force:
   ```bash
   git -C "$WORKTREE" push --no-follow-tags origin HEAD:refs/heads/fix-timeout
   ```
   Save the successful pushed full SHA as `PUSHED_HEAD`.
7. **FETCH fresh body**, then **EDIT**:
   ```bash
   gh pr view 42 -R acme/widget --json body
   # Decode JSON without trimming; write scratch bytes outside the repository.
   gh pr edit 42 -R acme/widget --body-file "$SCRATCH"
   ```

### Complete scratch body

Replace `<HEAD7>` with the pushed SHA’s first seven characters; use each fetched thread’s actual location rather than inventing paths. The original bytes remain unchanged, followed by one blank line:

```markdown
Original description

## Rework

Before: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa (local ref `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42` in the rework checkout)
Spec: doc/specs/rework.md at <HEAD7>
Keeps: retry behavior
Changes: repair timeout
Dropped claims: none
Verification: scoped - test-timeout; test-retry; lint; format; CI on this push holds the full run. Telemetry: whole PR against main.
Threads:
- <T1 location> - fixed in ddddddd
- <T2 location> - fixed (task "<T2 task title>" complete; no single commit names T2)
- <T3 location> - fixed (task "<T3 task title>" complete; no single commit names T3)
- <T4 location> - still open
- <T5 location> - still open
- <T6 location> - still open
- <T7 location> - declined - incompatible API
- <T8 location> - still open
```

T4’s naming commit/file touch and T5’s path match are not completion proof. Successful empty fetch substitutes `Threads: none`; failed fetch substitutes `Threads: not fetched (<reason>)` and does not invent resolutions.

“Dropped claims: none” does **not** mean every claim was dropped: omit `supersedes the description above`. Even when every claim is dropped, add that sentence on the block’s second line; never replace original bytes.

### Independent failure deltas

- **Strip:** `gauntlet: stuck plan strip failed` — stop before seal/ref/push.
- **Seal:** `gauntlet: stuck telemetry seal failed` — quote `seal failed record: denied`; stop before landing.
- **Ref update:** `gauntlet: stuck pre-rework ref creation failed` — stop before push.
- **Push rejection:** report once; skip body editing/closure; return to menu without retry or force.
- **Body edit:** `gauntlet: stuck PR description edit failed` — retain push, print the complete append block for manual paste; skip closure.

Preserve the worktree throughout. No thread replies, merges, or ticket changes. Success: `gauntlet: done pushed`, print seal stdout verbatim, then complete ship.
